meta.title: 确诊那一刻：大脑来不及反应的溺水感
meta.title_en: The Moment of Diagnosis: A Drowning Feeling Your Brain Can't Process

scenes.title_cn: 确诊第一反应：头脑空白
scenes.title_en: The first reaction: a blank mind
scenes.context: 讲者回忆确诊结果出来时的第一反应是没反应，表面冷静其实头脑空白。
sentences: 生病期间结果出来的时候，您第一反应是什么？我第一反应是没反应。
When the diagnosis came back during treatment, what was your first reaction? My first reaction was no reaction at all.
第一反应：first reaction
表面上冷静在探讨，其实我那个时候头脑是空白的，来不及做出反应。
Outwardly calm and analytical, but in truth my mind went blank — I couldn't react fast enough.
头脑空白：my mind went blank
我总体看起来还能够还算理性。
On the surface, I still looked reasonably composed.
还算理性：reasonably composed
paraphrase: 没反应≠冷静→是大脑来不及
No reaction isn't calmness; the brain just couldn't catch up.
Looking composed doesn't mean feeling steady.
scenes.speak: When the diagnosis came back during treatment, what was your first reaction? My first reaction was no reaction at all. Outwardly calm and analytical, but in truth my mind went blank — I couldn't react fast enough. On the surface, I still looked reasonably composed.

scenes.title_cn: 软弱的真相：需要肢体接触
scenes.context: 讲者解释被说软弱的原因——那段时间非常需要关爱和肢体接触。
sentences: 亲戚有这样的说法：他平时挺勇敢的，面临这种事情的时候没想到也比较软弱。
Relatives said: he's usually so brave, but facing this, unexpectedly he seemed weak too.
面临这种事情：facing something like this
我是很不善于表达感情的人，但在那个时候你会发现你需要肢体的接触。
I'm someone who's bad at expressing feelings, yet in those days I found myself craving physical contact.
肢体接触：physical contact
在那两个月里头，我有可能会拥抱过几次亲戚。
Over those two months, I probably hugged relatives a few times.
拥抱过几次：hugged a few times
paraphrase: 被说软弱→其实是需要关爱
Being called weak was really about needing care.
行为改变→身体在发出求救信号
The changed behavior was the body signaling for help.
scenes.speak: Relatives said: he's usually so brave, but facing this, unexpectedly he seemed weak too. I'm someone who's bad at expressing feelings, yet in those days I found myself craving physical contact. Over those two months, I probably hugged relatives a few times.

scenes.title_en: The drowning feeling: body before mind
scenes.context: 讲者把这种反应比作溺水：身体在做反应，大脑来不及反应，只想抓到温暖。
sentences: 在那个时候确实像溺水的感觉。
It genuinely felt like drowning.
像溺水：like drowning
溺水的时候由身体在做反应，你的大脑来不及做反应。
When you're drowning, your body reacts first; your brain can't keep up.
身体在做反应：the body reacts first
我就想要抓到一个东西，使我能够感觉到温暖、温度。
I just wanted to grab onto something that could make me feel warm again.
感觉到温暖：feel warmth
paraphrase: 溺水=身体先于大脑的本能反应
Grabbing onto something is survival, not dependence.
scenes.speak: It genuinely felt like drowning. When you're drowning, your body reacts first; your brain can't keep up. I just wanted to grab onto something that could make me feel warm again.

practice: My mind went blank — I couldn't react fast enough.
I found myself craving physical contact.
I just wanted to grab onto something warm.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My brain had no time to react.
✓ 地道说法：My mind went blank — I couldn't react fast enough.
went blank 比 had no time 更贴切地表达「来不及」。
✕ 直译腔：I need the touch of bodies.
✓ 地道说法：I found myself craving physical contact.
✕ 直译腔：I want to grasp a thing.
✓ 地道说法：I just wanted to grab onto something.
grab onto something 表达「抓住点什么」。
✕ 直译腔：He looked like he became weak.
✓ 地道说法：He seemed to have gone soft.
go soft 是「变软弱」的口语说法。
shifts: 确诊后没反应=冷血或坚强
那是头脑空白，来不及反应
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「结果出来的时候」保留原意，「需要肢体的接触」保留原意，「那人家就会觉得我行为改变了」按语境整理，「确实是像溺水的感觉」保留，「温暖温度」按语境整理。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
